python3 - <<'PY'
import json, sys, re
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
    sys.exit(0)
cmd = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '') or data.get('command', '') or ''
DANGEROUS = [
    r'rm\s+-rf\s+/',
    r'rm\s+-rf\s+~',
    r'sudo\s+rm',
    r':\s*>\s*/dev/sd',
    r'mkfs',
    r'git\s+push\s+.*--force',
    r'DROP\s+(TABLE|DATABASE)',
    r'del\s+/s\s+/q\s+C:\\',
]
for p in DANGEROUS:
    if re.search(p, cmd, re.IGNORECASE):
        print(json.dumps({'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'reason': 'High-risk destructive command blocked by LSTR Solo Harness guard.'}))
        sys.exit(2)
if re.search(r'(AWS_SECRET|PRIVATE KEY|BEGIN RSA|authorization|Bearer)\s*.*(curl|wget|nc|ssh)', cmd, re.IGNORECASE):
    print(json.dumps({'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'reason': 'Potential secret exfiltration blocked by LSTR Solo Harness guard.'}))
    sys.exit(2)
sys.exit(0)
PY
